none: PAS CAM-EB7952: Roman Coin : A silver, slightly bent, Siliqua of Magnus Maximus
contea di ritrovamento: Cambridgeshire (Inghilterra e Galles)
R/ VIRTVS RO-MANORVM ; D/ D N MAG MAX-MVS P F AVG

A silver, slightly bent, Siliqua of Magnus Maximus, AD383-388. AD383-388 (Reece period 20). Reverse legend reads VIRTVS RO-MANORVM. Reverse shows Roma seated facing holding globe and reversed spear. Mint is Trier. See RIC IX, p.29, no.84b. Obverse shows Pearl-diademed, draped and cuirassed bust right. Obverse legend reads D N MAG MAX-MVS P F AVG. Reverse fields and exergue read: / //TRPS.…
